retrievalProfile.description: A maximalist, symmetrical composition featuring a central floating portrait surrounded by grotesque monsters, sci-fi elements, and a deep indigo-to-magenta color palette.
triggerTerms: floating head portrait with sci-fi elements

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, symmetrical digital illustration centered on a realistic male portrait with vibrant purple hair. The portrait is flanked by two large, grotesque monsters inside ornate frames. The scene is filled with sci-fi and occult imagery including UFOs, cherubs, and mechanical parts, all unified by a glowing indigo and deep red color scheme.
coreVisualRelationships: Central portrait as the primary focal point
Symmetrical framing using grotesque monster figures
Atmospheric depth created by glowing purple backlighting
Foreground clutter of mechanical and organic debris
Top-down sci-fi elements like UFOs and robotic entities
coreInvariants: Dominant indigo and magenta color palette
Symmetrical composition with a central floating head

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central portrait head, scaled to occupy the middle third of the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing purple hair of the central figure acts as the primary light source and anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular path starting from the central face, moving outward to the flanking monsters, up to the UFOs, and down through the foreground debris.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is maximalist with stars and nebulae filling any gaps between characters.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Indigo and deep purple for atmosphere and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright magenta and red for monster details and foreground elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Glowing cyan and gold for eyes, jewelry, and energy effects.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the mid-tones with deep, crushed blacks in the shadows and bright, glowing highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid natural greens or earthy browns

letterConstructionRules: Letters are constructed from crystalline or metallic shards
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are broken into segments to resemble floating debris

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the bottom of the central portrait

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A clean, small sans-serif metadata line placed directly beneath the large display text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, futuristic geometric structure.
Captures the shattered, mineral-like texture of the letters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical surrealist illustration with a central floating male head with purple hair, flanked by two grotesque monsters in frames, with UFOs and stars in a deep indigo sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, wide, shattered crystalline display title in the lower center, using a white-to-cyan gradient with a neon glow.

verificationChecks: Does the purple hair glow against the background?
Are the letters rendered as 3D shattered objects?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos

mustAchieve: Complex layering of foreground and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text looks like physical 3D shards
Confirm the presence of sci-fi elements like UFOs
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Portrait + Grotesque Framing + Sci-Fi/Occult Props + Indigo/Magenta Lighting + Shattered 3D Typography
